title: Restraining an attacker to stop an assault
description: A bystander physically restrains a person who is actively assaulting another, using the minimum force necessary, and releases them as soon as the threat ends.
intended_goal: Stop an ongoing assault with the minimum force necessary.

available_alternatives.title: Do nothing
available_alternatives.notes: Allows the assault to continue: higher total coercion suffered by the victim.

available_alternatives.title: Verbal de-escalation only
available_alternatives.notes: Less coercive, but not feasible against an active physical assault.

prior_coercion_description: An active physical assault by the attacker on the victim.
expected_consequences: The assault stops; the attacker is briefly restrained and then released.

justification.justification_notes: Minimum force; restraint ends once the threat is neutralized.
